    )

Rules.InvariantScript:
With(
    {
        varFilteredGenerators: AddColumns(
            Filter(
                GeneratorInProjects,
                AsType(
                    ModuleTypeInProject,
                    GeneratorTypeInProjects
                ).GeneratorTypeInProject = ThisItem.GeneratorTypeInProject
            ),
            Index,
            Value(
                Last(
                    Split(
                        Name,
                        "_"
                    )
                ).Value
            ),
            FormatedEffectiveCpacity,
            Text(
                ThisRecord.'Effective Capacity',
                "#0.0#"
            ),
            FormatedHubHeight,
            If(
                Not(IsBlank(ThisRecord.'Effective Hub Height')),
                Text(
                    ThisRecord.'Effective Hub Height',
                    "#0.00"
                )
            ),
            TotalHeight,
            Text(ThisRecord.'Total Height',"#0.0#"),
            TagColor,
            If(
                ThisRecord.'Effective Hub Height Changed',
                "rgb(0, 125, 215)",
                "rgb(255, 255, 255)"
            ),
            TagBorderColor,
            "rgb(0,137,147)",
            ImageColor,
            "rgb(255, 172, 28)"
        )
    },
    AddColumns(
        Sort(
            varFilteredGenerators,
            Index,
            SortOrder.Ascending
        ),
        EditIcon,
        "icon:Edit",
        DeleteIcon,
        "icon:Delete",
        RecordKey,
        ThisRecord.GeneratorInProject,
        InformationIcon,
        If(
            And(
                ThisRecord.'Total Height' > locProjectPlanning.'Height limitation [m]',
                Not(IsBlank(ThisRecord.'Total Height')),
                Not(IsBlank(locProjectPlanning.'Height limitation [m]'))
            ),
            "icon:Info"
        )
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_GeneratorData_RightPanel_Form_PvModuleType_Fields_PVCapacityMW.Value)),
        Not(fn_Numeric_Generators.IsTwoDecimal(txt_GeneratorData_RightPanel_Form_PvModuleType_Fields_PVCapacityMW.Value))
    ),
    $"Numeric value with maximum of two decimals",
    Not(
        fn_Numeric_Generators.InRange(
            txt_GeneratorData_RightPanel_Form_PvModuleType_Fields_PVCapacityMW.Value,
            0,
            500
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and 500."
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_GeneratorData_RightPanel_Form_PvModuleType_Fields_PVCapacityMW.Value)),
        Or(
            Not(IsNumeric(txt_GeneratorData_RightPanel_Form_PvModuleType_Fields_PVCapacityMW.Value)),
            IsMatch(
                txt_GeneratorData_RightPanel_Form_PvModuleType_Fields_PVCapacityMW.Value,
                "[.,]",
                MatchOptions.Contains
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Value must be a number without decimals",
    And(
        IsNumeric(txt_GeneratorData_RightPanel_Form_PvModuleType_Fields_PVCapacityMW.Value),
        Not(
            And(
                Value(txt_GeneratorData_RightPanel_Form_PvModuleType_Fields_PVCapacityMW.Value) >= 1,
                Value(txt_GeneratorData_RightPanel_Form_PvModuleType_Fields_PVCapacityMW.Value) <= 500
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 1 and 500."
)

    )}."
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    IsBlank(locSelectedGeneratorInProject.'Effective Capacity'),
    Text(
        locSelectedGeneratorEntity.Generator.'Specific Capacity',
        "#0.0#"
    ),
    Text(
        locSelectedGeneratorInProject.'Effective Capacity',
        "#0.0#"
    )
)

If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_GeneratorData_RightPanel_Form_Fields_Effective_Capacity.Value)),
        Not(fn_Numeric_Generators.IsTwoDecimal(txt_GeneratorData_RightPanel_Form_Fields_Effective_Capacity.Value))
    ),
    $"Value must be a numeric",
    Not(
        fn_Numeric_Production.InRange(
            txt_Production_DisplayProject_Body_Form_GrossYield.Value,
            0.01,
            locSelectedGeneratorEntity.Generator.'Specific Capacity'
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0.01 and {Text(
        locSelectedGeneratorEntity.Generator.'Specific Capacity',
        "#.0#"
    )} MW max."
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    Or(
        IsBlank(locSelectedGeneratorInProject),
        IsBlank(locSelectedGeneratorInProject.'Hub Height excl. Foundation Plinth [m]')
    ),
    Text(
        locSelectedGeneratorEntity.Generator.'Hub Height',
        "#0.00"
    ),
    Text(
        locSelectedGeneratorInProject.'Hub Height excl. Foundation Plinth [m]',
        "#0.00"
    )
)

If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_GeneratorData_RightPanel_Form_Fields_Effective_HubHeight.Value)),
        Not(fn_Numeric_Generators.IsTwoDecimal(txt_GeneratorData_RightPanel_Form_Fields_Effective_HubHeight.Value))
    ),
    $"Numeric value with maximum of two decimals",
    Not(
        fn_Numeric_Production.InRange(
            txt_Production_DisplayProject_Body_Form_GrossYield.Value,
            1,
            200
        )
    ),
    $"Effective hub height needs to be a positive number below 200 m."
)

Rules.InvariantScript: "Total height exceeds Height Limitation, Only Project Managers can Override to Save."

And(
    locSelectedGeneratorInProject.'Total Height' > locProjectPlanning.'Height limitation [m]',
    Not(IsBlank(locProjectPlanning.'Height limitation [m]')),
    Not(IsBlank(locSelectedGeneratorInProject.'Total Height')),
    gblRecordSelectedProject.'Project Manager'.Id <> User().EntraObjectId
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(locGeneratorCostsPerWtg)),
        IsNumeric(locGeneratorCostsPerWtg)
    ),
    Text(
        locGeneratorCostsPerWtg,
        "#0.00"
    ),
    Text(
        locSelectedGeneratorEntity.'Cost per WTG',
        "#0.00"
    )
)

With(
    {
        varFielValue: Trim(txt_GeneratorData_RightPanel_Form_Fields_Cost.Value),
        varMaxCost: Switch(
            gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code',
            "EUR",
            15000000,
            15000000 * 5
        )
    },
    If(
        IsBlank(varFielValue),
        gblAppResx.InputBlank,
        Not(fn_Numeric_Generators.IsTwoDecimal(varFielValue)),
        gblAppResx.NumericTwoDecimals,
        Not(
            fn_Numeric_Generators.InRange(
                varFielValue,
                0,
                varMaxCost
            )
        ),
        $"Please select a value between 0 and {Text(
            varMaxCost,
            "#,###.0#"
        )}."
    )
)
